notes.title: New version 1.0.1
notes.content:
Fixed a rare stalemate situation where the enemy had only ranged left, so they could not capture the camp, you could not either from same reason, but nobody could end the battle.
 Fixed a bug where the inventory was not reset between runs.
 In addition to destroying the shield token, spears also do 10 damage and have a 100% critical hit chance.
 ESC show/hide the in-game menu (can be configured in the settings)

notes.title: Roadmap
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825974/f2860dee30d992c363e61402cde00ae0f4b67580.png

Battle Goals
Battles will have more objectives than just conquering the opponent's camp. The new set will include well-known RTS mechanics such as Assassination, Hostage Situations, Survival, and more, depending on what works best. We are addressing some reviews that mentioned battle repetitiveness.

Roguelite elements
The game will feature optional roguelite elements. We plan to implement legacy points that you can collect during runs and spend to acquire permanent wisdoms. Additionally, we plan to give chieftains special abilities, such as the ability to retain reinforcements from battles.

?
Please let us know what you would like to see on the roadmap. We are considering a one-screen mode, multiplayer PvP duels, new game modes, and more.

notes.title: Tribe Nation is participating in its first two festivals!
notes.content:
Steam Endless Replayability Fest
Tribe Nation has been selected to participate in the Steam Endless Replayability Fest from May 13-20, because, yes, infinite replayability is a feature of Tribe Nation. Each playthrough will be different, with some parts of the game procedurally generated.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825974/122e5b7c27e7bbb7f59f933de5a147e65bdea888.png

Digital Dragons in Krakow
Early next week, specifically on May 20-21, we will have a booth at Digital Dragons in Krakow, Poland. 
For the very first time, interested individuals will be able to try playing Tribe Nation. 
We are eagerly anticipating the reactions of the players.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825974/8969aaf31dc58545134d8a4f85345ed7824caed5.jpg

Currently, we are fine-tuning Tribe Nation to ensure an enjoyable experience for players. 
Recent updates include:
    • Adding tooltips for inventory, nobility, merchants, resources, and more. 
    • Adjusting characteristics such as the amount of starting resources, prices, loot, etc.
    • Allowing enemies to change formations and control sacred sites.
    • Correctly calculating weapon and squad ranks.
    • Fixing numerous bugs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825974/1ead80425ab0d5dde52134aa76ea976699e1aa96.gif

Be sure to visit our booth at Digital Dragons if you have the chance. We look forward to seeing you there!

notes.title: Developer Diary #1
notes.content:
Greetings, brave chieftains!

Time for a quick dive into the making of Tribe Nation. We spilled the beans on our  RTS and roguelite combo set during the Gallic Wars not too long ago, and the response has been pretty great. Thank you!

Development Hustle: Six Months Down, More to Go
So, we've been at this for about half a year now. Still got some roguelite tricks up our sleeves, but let's talk about what's been cooking in the RTS pot, especially the battle hex map. 

Check out this quick GIF of how the appearance of the randomly generated maps has changed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825974/87a42f8273833ff25b3e63ebed126c6d34ac036a.gif

Battle Shenanigans: Building Stuff, Riding Things
The combat side of things is starting to look pretty good. You can build fortifications, erect structures like towers, bridges or defensive walls, roll out vehicles and mobile war machines such as rammer and siege tower or catapults, and yeah, ride a horse or chariot. It's been a wild ride from basic moves to this. 

Peep this GIF showing how units and machines have been getting their act together.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825974/b6c45747d08348dd0247a7a72180bb11effe449c.gif

Units, Gear, and a Bit of Historical Swagger
Now, let's talk soldiers. We're all about historical flair here. No cloak, no existence, right? So, our soldiers are rocking historically appropriate gear, including cloaks. You'll spot wire helmets, wooden helmets, linothorax, metal helmets. Swords, bows, pikes, slingshots, and Celtic Cleavers are in the arsenal. We believe in the details, and it's not just about what they wear; it's about how they fight. 

Check out this GIF showing the first fight and how things have evolved after six months.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825974/b2b24a8a68226e2ddfb74ee3d413aeec8d2d8532.gif


Next Up: Crafting the Non-Combat Stuff
We're knee-deep in making the non-combat part more interesting and nicer - you know, looting, shops, wisdom, inventory, crafting, and the whole text adventure package. Currently fine-tuning the user interface to make sure you can smoothly transition between tactical warfare and some roguelike wandering.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825974/460f69ba522f1168b649eceacccdfef5358228d1.gif
